header.title: Lead Actions
header.description: Control what this role can do on the leads pages.

showAddLead.label: Show "Add New Lead" on All Leads
showAddLead.hint: Pick a campaign type and an audience, then fill that audience's form. A counsellor's lead is assigned to themselves; an admin chooses the counsellor. Off for every role by default.

allowEditFormResponses.label: Allow editing lead form answers
allowEditFormResponses.hint: Shows an Edit button on the Form Response card in the Lead Profile tab, to correct a lead's answers. On for admin by default, off for other roles.
